name: LA Story
overview: This friend group has been tight since freshman year and has had their ups and downs, hookups, breakups and breakdowns. But in the end, they somehow manage to stick together. In AwesomenessTV's new docu-series, you not only get to know the squad but see into the lives of these 6 boys and 6 girls. The drama is relentless and maintaining their friendship is the ultimate prize!
